resources.string: Lets whoever is connected with rdesk touch and type on this phone

While access to this phone is on in rdesk, whoever is connected sees the screen; with this on, their mouse and keyboard also touch, scroll and type here (the system actions Back, Home and Recents too). rdesk uses it for nothing else: it reads no screen content except the field being typed into, and keeps nothing. Turn access off in rdesk, or this off here, to stop it.
